title: VRCX-K Plugin Index Entry
description: One entry in a plugin SOURCE's index. A source is a table of id -> how to fetch it, plus a DISPLAY CACHE. It is not authoritative about anything that lives in the author's repository: version, permissions, dependencies and checksums are deliberately absent so that publishing a release requires no PR here. See docs/plugin-source-and-index-design.md.

id.description: Stable plugin identifier. Also the key users see as {source}/{id}@{version}.

type.description: Official FUNCTION category. Closed enum, and the only machine-reliable filter axis — free tags cannot be (utility/tools/工具 would each be spelled differently). Chosen deliberately narrow so that adding a value later is rare.

source.description: Where to fetch the plugin. This is the index's ONLY authoritative content: without it nothing can be retrieved.

name.description: Display cache. The manifest in the author's repository is authoritative; an out-of-date value here is harmless and self-corrects when the plugin is installed.

author.description: Identity signal, mirrored here so a change of owner is visible while browsing. Not an authenticator.

repository.description: Source repository, used for display and as an identity signal.

tags.description: Free-form, author-chosen labels. Purely presentational: they are NOT a reliable filter axis, which is what `type` is for. Colour is a display-layer concern carried by the source, not the plugin.

PluginType.description: core = official core capability (login/db/connection); library = provides functionality to other plugins (NoneBot's `library`); feature = user-visible functionality; ui = interface extension; integration = third-party platform bridge; tool = utility.

url.description: Git repository URL. MUST end in `.git`: the suffix doubles as the discriminator, which is why there is no `type` field on the source (design P3). NOTE codeload rejects the suffix (404), so any DERIVED url (codeload tarball, raw file) must strip it first — that normalisation belongs in exactly one function.

path.description: Plugin directory inside the repository, for monorepos. Omitted = repository root. Must not escape the repository: a `..` segment anywhere (including a trailing one) is rejected, as is a leading `/`. The manifest is read from `<path>/.vrcxk/manifest.json`, so its location is always derivable and needs no field of its own.

color.description: Optional display colour, taken from the NoneBot store convention [{"label": ..., "color": "#ea5252"}].
